task: Sorter tray routing data reset on order cancellation. When a parent order is cancelled mid-conveyance, clear the sorter tray routing so empty/cancelled boxes go to the rejection lane instead of shipping.
checklist: WCS listens for ORDER_CANCELLED webhooks from OMS
System sends CLEAR_TRAY_ROUTING command to the PLC
Tray payload is wiped -> box defaults to the rejection lane
Negative: non-cancelled order -> routing is untouched
Edge: cancellation arrives after the box already shipped -> safe no-op, no invalid command
Edge: PLC acknowledgement missing/timeout -> retry; box is NOT routed to courier by stale data
Race: cancel and sort-assignment near-simultaneous -> deterministic outcome
Audit: cancellation -> clear command -> outcome are logged end to end
